xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company has received an order from the Joint Commissioner of Customs Adjudication (I), ACC, Mumbai Zone-III under Section 28(4) of the Customs Act, 1962, raising a demand of ₹4,50,835/- for short-paid duty due to an incorrect exemption claim under Notification No. 46/2011-Customs, along with applicable interest. The order also imposes a penalty equivalent to the duty and interest under Section 114A, and a Redemption Fine of ₹7,00,000/- under Section 125(1), as the imported goods are no longer available for confiscation.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Company has filed a further appeal before the Appellate Authority against the order.
